title: Cost-effectiveness and budget impact analyses of strategies to improve measles vaccination coverage in Kenya.
abstract: Measles control efforts have been implemented over the years. However, elimination of the disease is yet to be realized. Additionally, global measles vaccination coverage has stagnated over the past decade, leading to outbreaks. We assessed the cost-effectiveness and budget impact of scaling-up vaccination coverage in Kenya, towards the measles elimination goal. A cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted using a Markov model from a health system's perspective over a 10-year time frame, incorporating a new birth cohort annually. Two vaccination scenarios were examined 1) a constant coverage improvement scenario, assuming current funding is maintained resulting in annual increases of 0.3% and 2% in the first and second-dose measles vaccine coverage, respectively, alongside supplementary immunization activities(SIAs) and 2) an intensified investment scenario, assuming achievement of 95% coverage for both vaccine doses in addition to SIAs. The later assumed increased investments to reach hard-to-reach populations. A threshold of USD 1,280 per disability adjusted life year (DALY) averted was applied. A budget impact analysis was also conducted. Over a 10-year time horizon, the constant coverage improvement scenario led to 6% fewer deaths (213 (161-276)) and was cost-effective (incremental cost-effectiveness ratio, ICER = USD 1,269 ($1,205-$1,333) per DALY averted) compared to the base scenario. Increasing coverage in the intensified investment scenario, further reduced deaths by 25% (879(626--1,284)) and was more cost effective, ICER 1,093 (1,029 -1,157) per DALY averted, compared to the constant improvement scenario. The constant improvement scenario had a moderate budget impact while the intensified improvement scenario had a very high budget impact, when assessed against Kenya's health expenditure. Our findings suggest that accelerating measles coverage through intensified investments towards measles elimination is cost-effective but has a high budget impact. Therefore, policy makers should consider market shaping interventions and strategies to mobilize and allocate sufficient resources to increase vaccination coverage and ensure sustained health gains.

title: The risk of idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura after first and second measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine doses in children born in England 2000-2019.
abstract: We assessed the risk of Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) after Measles Mumps Rubella vaccine (MMR) doses 1 and 2 in children in England born from 2000 to 2019. After linking hospitalised ITP episodes to MMR vaccine records, we used the self-control case-series method to assess the relative incidence in the 6-week period post vaccination. We also assessed the risk of ITP after dose 2 in those who had ITP after dose 1. We found an increased risk of ITP after dose 1 (relative incidence 2.38 (95% CI: 2.12-2.67)) with an attributable risk of 1 in 42,900 doses. We found no evidence of an increased risk after dose 2 (relative incidence 0.96 (95% CI: 0.81-1.13)). Furthermore, we found that the 336 children with ITP after dose 1 who had MMR dose 2 had no increased risk in the 6-weeks after this dose and that it is therefore safe to vaccinate these children.

source_body_en: We assessed the risk of Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) after Measles Mumps Rubella vaccine (MMR) doses 1 and 2 in children in England born from 2000 to 2019. After linking hospitalised ITP episodes to MMR vaccine records, we used the self-control case-series method to assess the relative incidence in the 6-week period post vaccination. We also assessed the risk of ITP after dose 2 in those who had ITP after dose 1. We found an increased risk of ITP after dose 1 (relative incidence 2.38 (95% CI: 2.12-2.67)) with an attributable risk of 1 in 42,900 doses. We found no evidence of an increased risk after dose 2 (relative incidence 0.96 (95% CI: 0.81-1.13)). Furthermore, we found that the 336 children with ITP after dose 1 who had MMR dose 2 had no increased risk in the 6-weeks after this dose and that it is therefore safe to vaccinate these children.

title: SUBACUTE SCLEROSING PANENCEPHALITIS: CLINICAL REVIEW OF PATHOGENESIS, DIAGNOSIS AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: Introduction: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a rare, chronic, progressive and fatal neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent infection with mutant Measles virus. It develops years after primary measles infection and predominantly affects children and adolescents, leading to severe neurological deterioration. Aim: The aim of this paper is to review the etiology, pathogenesis, clinical representation, diagnostic criteria, treatment options and prevention strategies related to SSPE. Methodology: This paper is based on a literature review using medical textbooks and scientific articles addressing the epidemiology, diagnosis and management of SSPE. Results: SSPE commonly presents with behavioral and cognitive decline, myoclonic jerks, motor dysfunction, seizures and progressive loss of neurological function. Diagnosis is established through characteristic clinical findings, electroencephalography changes, neuroimaging and elevated measles antibody in cerebrospinal fluid. Current treatment options including antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, may slow disease progression in some patients, but prognosis remains poor in most cases. Conclusion: SSPE remains a devastating late complication of measles infection with limited therapeutic success. Early recognition is important for supportive management, while prevention through effective measles vaccination remains the most important strategy for reducing the incidence, morbidity and mortality associated with this disease.

abstract_zh: 引言:亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE)是由突变麻疹病毒引起的罕见、慢性、进行性和致命性神经退行性疾病。它通常在初次麻疹感染数年后发生,主要影响儿童和青少年,导致严重的神经功能恶化。目的:本文旨在回顾与SSPE相关的病因、诊断、临床表现、诊断标准、治疗选择和预防策略。方法:本文基于使用医学教科书和科学文章进行的文献回顾,涵盖SSPE的诊断、管理及治疗。结果:SSPE常见表现为行为和认知功能下降、肌阵挛性抽搐、运动功能障碍、癫痫发作以及进行性神经功能丧失。诊断通过特征性临床表现、脑电图变化、神经影像学检查以及脑脊液中麻疹病毒抗体升高来确立。目前的治疗选择包括抗病毒药物和免疫调节治疗,可能在某些患者中减缓疾病进展,但大多数情况下预后仍较差。结论:SSPE仍然是麻疹病毒感染的一种毁灭性的晚期并发症,治疗效果有限。早期识别对于支持性管理至关重要,而通过有效的疫苗接种进行预防则是减少该病相关发病率、患病率和死亡率的最重要策略。

title: Measles-Related Macular Necrotizing Retinitis in an Unvaccinated Adult: A Case Report
abstract: PURPOSE: To describe the clinical features, multimodal imaging (MMI) findings, and therapeutic management in a case of asynchronous bilateral macular necrotizing measles-related retinitis in an unvaccinated adult. METHODS: Observational case report. RESULTS: A 36-year-old unvaccinated male presented with acute vision loss in the right eye. He had a past history of idiopathic encephalitis and prior necrotizing retinitis in the contralateral eye. MMI revealed full-thickness macular retinitis with the characteristic "moth-eaten" appearance accompanied by the "ballooning" of an intact internal limiting membrane (ILM) on optical coherence tomography (OCT). Both intraocular fluid and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) PCR, and the CSF/serum measles-specific antibody index, were non-diagnostic contributory, a known limitation in late-onset, compartmentalized measles complications. Diagnosis was reached through integration of clinical history, systemic seropositivity, and hallmark MMI features. A combined treatment regimen of remdesivir, pegylated interferon alpha-2a, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) appeared to halt disease progression and preserved central vision. CONCLUSION: Late-onset measles retinitis poses a significant diagnostic challenge, as negative direct molecular testing may mislead clinicians and delay appropriate treatment. This case underscores the critical role of systemic serology, MMI, and structured clinical reasoning in reaching a timely diagnosis. In an era of declining vaccination coverage, clinicians should maintain a high index of suspicion for measles-related ocular complications.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare and severe ocular complication of measles in an unvaccinated adult, highlighting the challenges in diagnosing late-onset measles retinitis. The patient presented with acute vision loss and a history of prior retinitis in the contralateral eye. Multimodal imaging revealed characteristic features of macular necrotizing retinitis, while PCR and serological tests were non-diagnostic. The authors emphasize the importance of integrating clinical history, serology, and imaging for accurate diagnosis. The case underscores the need for heightened clinical suspicion in measles-related ocular complications, especially in areas with declining vaccination rates. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述一例未接种疫苗成人异步双侧黄斑坏死性麻疹相关视网膜炎的临床特征、多模态影像学表现及治疗管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项观察性病例报告涉及一名36岁未接种疫苗男性,他因右眼急性视力下降就诊,并且有特发性脑炎病史以及左眼曾发生过坏死性视网膜炎的既往史。
elements_zh.methods: 通过整合临床病史、系统性血清阳性反应以及标志性多模态影像学特征,最终确诊为诊断。眼内液和脑脊液(CSF)的PCR检测以及CSF/血清麻疹特异性抗体指数均为非诊断性,这是已知的晚期发病、分隔性麻疹并发症的局限性。
elements_zh.main_results: 多模态影像学显示黄斑全层视网膜炎,具有典型的" moth-eaten "(蛾食状)外观,并伴有光学相干断层扫描(OCT)上完整内层视网膜限制膜(ILM)的" ballooning "(气球样膨出)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,晚期发病的麻疹视网膜炎具有显著的诊断挑战,因为直接分子检测结果为阴性可能会误导临床医生并延迟适当的治疗治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本病例强调了系统性血清学、多模态影像学以及结构化临床推理在及时诊断麻疹相关眼部并发症中的关键作用,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率下降的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于PCR和血清学检测在晚期发病的麻疹并发症中具有非诊断性,因此该研究存在局限性,这可能会影响诊断的可靠性。由于依赖于单一病例报告,证据强度被评定为中等。

abstract_zh: 目的:描述一例未接种疫苗成人异步双侧黄斑坏死性麻疹相关视网膜炎的临床特征、多模态影像学(MMI)表现及治疗管理。方法:观察性病例报告。结果:一名36岁未接种疫苗男性因右眼急性视力下降就诊。他有特发性脑炎病史,并且左眼曾发生过坏死性视网膜炎。多模态影像学显示黄斑全层视网膜炎,具有典型的" moth-eaten "(蛾食状)外观,并伴有光学相干断层扫描(OCT)上完整内层视网膜限制膜(ILM)的" ballooning "(气球样膨出)。眼内液和脑脊液(CSF)的PCR检测以及CSF/血清麻疹特异性抗体指数均为非诊断性,这是已知的晚期发病、分隔性麻疹并发症的局限性。通过整合临床病史、系统性血清阳性反应以及标志性多模态影像学特征,最终确诊为诊断。采用联合治疗治疗方案,包括瑞德西韦、聚乙二醇干扰素α-2a和静脉注射免疫球蛋白(IVIg),似乎能够阻止疾病进展并保留中心视力。结论:晚期发病的麻疹视网膜炎具有显著的诊断挑战,因为直接分子检测结果为阴性可能会误导临床医生并延迟适当的治疗治疗。本病例强调了系统性血清学、多模态影像学以及结构化临床推理在及时诊断麻疹相关眼部并发症中的关键作用,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率下降的背景下。

title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
abstract: BACKGROUND: Delays in vaccination with the first/second dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. METHODS: A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12-35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24-35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. RESULTS: Overall, 651 children aged 12-35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24-35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. CONCLUSIONS: Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

abstract_zh: 背景:在接种含疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的麻疹疫苗的第一/第二剂时出现延迟会增加传播的风险。MCV2于2019年被纳入埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划,接种年龄为15个月。我们描述了在MCV2引入后,儿童接种疫苗接种的年龄及其与及时接种相关的特征。方法:对埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州2021年一项针对12-35个月儿童的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种接种状态和接种年龄是从儿童的疫苗接种卡中确定的。估计了24-35个月儿童中MCV1和MCV2的累计卡确认接种覆盖率,按接种年龄进行分析。使用多变量逻辑回归分析了与及时MCV1接种相关的特征,并按城乡进行分层。结果:总体分析了651名12-35个月的儿童(MCV1)和其中270名24-35个月的儿童(MCV2)。MCV1的累计接种覆盖率为9个月时59.9%,12个月时76.3%;MCV2的累计接种覆盖率为15个月时33.0%,24个月时44.8%。MCV接种覆盖率在城市地区普遍高于农村地区。在接种过疫苗的儿童中,早期、及时和延迟接种的比例分别为MCV1的30.1%、44.5%和25.3%,以及MCV2的28.6%、41.2%和30.3%。与及时MCV1接种相关的特征在城乡地区有所不同,但共同主题包括增加的照顾者疫苗接种意识和服务提供方面。结论:尽管大多数接种MCV1的儿童在12个月内完成了接种,但许多儿童接种时间有所延迟。无论接种时间如何,MCV2的接种覆盖率都较低。这些发现强调了常规补种政策和指导的重要性,并突出了在城乡地区制定针对性策略以提高MCV接种覆盖率和及时接种的必要性。

title: Threat Amplified, Blame Restrained: LLM-Assisted Media Framing Analysis of the 2026 Bangladesh Measles Outbreak
abstract: How news media frame and emotionally code a public health emergency shapes public risk perception and trust, yet outbreak-coverage dynamics remain understudied for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We examine sentiment and stance in English-language Bangladeshi coverage of the 2026 measles outbreak -- the country's most severe in two decades, with over 97,000 suspected cases and 600 deaths across 61 of 64 districts, unfolding after the 2024 change of government and a 2024-2025 vaccine stockout. Using the Internet Archive, we build a reproducible corpus of 403 headlines from seven national outlets (396 in-window in 2026), label them for binary sentiment and four-way stance via a large language model under a locked codebook, and validate against a two-coder human-adjudicated gold standard (n=153; Cohen's kappa=0.89 stance, 0.75 sentiment). Aligned to the DGHS epidemic curve, coverage grew significantly more negative (56% to 88% negative; Cochran-Armitage z=4.12, p<.001) and risk-amplification framing intensified (44% to 84%; z=4.15, p<.001). Media negativity lagged incidence, tracking cumulative mortality. Contrary to the political backdrop, blame remained a minority frame (~9% overall) and was overwhelmingly systemic (32 of 37, 86%) rather than directed at named actors. The pipeline offers a scalable, transparent method for LMIC outbreak-media analysis; Bangladeshi coverage amplified threat far more than it assigned political blame.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how news media framed the 2026 measles outbreak in Bangladesh, focusing on sentiment and stance in English-language coverage. The outbreak, the most severe in two decades, involved over 97,000 suspected cases and 600 deaths across 61 districts. The research used a corpus of 403 headlines from seven national outlets, labeled by a large language model and validated by human coders. Results showed a significant increase in negative coverage and risk-amplification framing over time, with media negativity lagging behind incidence but aligning with cumulative mortality. The study highlights the importance of media framing in shaping public perception during public health emergencies, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. The analysis provides a scalable method for media evaluation in such contexts, emphasizing the amplification of threat over political blame. The findings suggest that media coverage can influence public trust and risk perception, but the study does not report specific limitations or evidence strength assessment.

title: Seroprotection after measles vaccination in children with sickle cell anemia receiving hydroxyurea.
abstract: Children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) may have decreased antibody responses after some routine vaccines, but it is not known whether this affects the response to measles vaccination. It is critical to determine whether children with SCA develop adequate seroprotection after measles vaccination considering the rise in measles infections in the United States and persistent transmission globally, particularly in regions with high SCA prevalence. It is also unknown whether concurrent hydroxyurea treatment affects the measles antibody response to vaccination. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of children with SCA enrolled in the TREAT trial to determine antimeasles seroprotection (immunoglobulin G of ≥200 IU/L via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) after first and second measles vaccine (MV1 and MV2, respectively). Seroprotection was reached by 33 of 35 children (94%) after MV1 and by 46 of 50 (92%) after MV2. Each additional year of age at MV2 was associated with decreased odds of seroprotection (odds ratio [OR], 0.25; P = .02). Hydroxyurea treatment at the time of vaccination did not reduce seroprotection; rather, earlier hydroxyurea initiation was associated with increased seroprotection (OR, 4.4; P = .02). Most children with SCA are adequately protected after measles vaccination, similar to the general population, and seroprotection is increased with timely vaccination and early hydroxyurea treatment. This trial was registered at www.clinicaltrials.gov as NCT02286154.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess whether children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) receiving hydroxyurea achieve adequate seroprotection after measles vaccination, addressing a knowledge gap regarding vaccine efficacy in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on children with SCA enrolled in the TREAT trial, examining antimeasles seroprotection after first and second measles vaccinations (MV1 and MV2).
analysis.methods: Seroprotection was measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) to detect immunoglobulin G (IgG) levels of ≥200 IU/L, with statistical analysis of odds ratios and P values to assess associations with age and hydroxyurea treatment initiation.
analysis.main_results: Seroprotection was achieved by 33 of 35 children (94%) after MV1 and by 46 of 50 (92%) after MV2. Each additional year of age at MV2 was associated with decreased odds of seroprotection (OR, 0.25; P = .02). Earlier hydroxyurea initiation was linked to increased seroprotection (OR, 4.4; P = .02).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that most children with SCA are adequately protected after measles vaccination, with seroprotection rates comparable to the general population, and that early hydroxyurea treatment may enhance vaccine response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform measles vaccination strategies for children with SCA, highlighting the importance of timely vaccination and the potential benefit of early hydroxyurea treatment in improving seroprotection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the clear association between hydroxyurea initiation and seroprotection, supported by statistically significant odds ratios.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated measles vaccine seroprotection in children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) receiving hydroxyurea. It found that 94% of children achieved seroprotection after the first dose and 92% after the second. Age at vaccination was inversely associated with seroprotection, while earlier hydroxyurea treatment was linked to increased protection. These results suggest that timely vaccination and early hydroxyurea use may enhance measles immunity in SCA patients, aligning with general population outcomes. The study's retrospective design limits its strength, but the findings are supported by significant statistical associations.

title: Cost of a Measles Outbreak in an Urban Shelter
abstract: Importance: Measles outbreaks are costly and challenging to control. A measles outbreak associated with a Chicago, Illinois, shelter, which primarily affected shelter residents, resulted in substantial public health response costs, direct medical costs, and productivity losses. Objective: To evaluate the societal burden of the 2024 Chicago measles outbreak in terms of resources used and costs. Design, Setting, and Participants: This economic evaluation analyzed the costs of a shelter-associated measles outbreak in Chicago between March 7 and April 30, 2024, in terms of measles cases, contacts (children, adult residents, shelter personnel), and relevant agencies involved in the outbreak response. Exposure: Measles virus. Main Outcomes and Measures: Three types of costs were estimated in this limited societal cost analysis: (1) total response costs (personnel time, vaccination, quarantine space, transportation, laboratory testing, and other materials) incurred by the Chicago Department of Public Health and partner agencies; (2) direct medical costs (case isolation in hospitals, emergency department visits, treatment, interfacility emergency transportation, and infrastructure modifications); and (3) productivity losses due to isolation, quarantine, or informal caregiving (including number of days children were excluded from school). Results: There were 57 measles cases (including 30 females [52.6%]; median [IQR] age, 3 [1-22] years) and 3569 contacts (including 1837 females [51.6%]; median [IQR] age, 17 [7-30] years) associated with the shelter outbreak. The associated societal cost was $8 700 258, or $152 636 per measles case. Response costs included $1 798 780 in personnel costs, $1 397 976 in vaccination costs, $200 489 in laboratory testing costs, $104 263 in transportation costs, and $63 023 in other material costs. Direct medical costs were $4 399 639, and estimated productivity losses were $683 895, with 17 113 school days among children lost due to the outbreak. Conclusions and Relevance: This economic evaluation of a measles outbreak in a congregate setting found complex response challenges that contributed to substantial costs. This outbreak response was one of the most expensive in the measles postelimination era due to the large costs associated with vaccination and isolation and quarantine in hospitals. Though the outbreak placed a considerable cost burden on both public health and health care systems, rapid disease identification and mass vaccination among shelter residents prevented a more costly and larger outbreak. Strategies to reduce disease transmission and costs during outbreaks among undervaccinated populations living in congregate settings may include funding non-health care isolation and quarantine spaces and vaccinating new shelter residents on arrival.

title_zh: 城市避难所中麻疹 暴发的费用
source_body_en: Importance: Measles outbreaks are costly and challenging to control. A measles outbreak associated with a Chicago, Illinois, shelter, which primarily affected shelter residents, resulted in substantial public health response costs, direct medical costs, and productivity losses. Objective: To evaluate the societal burden of the 2024 Chicago measles outbreak in terms of resources used and costs. Design, Setting, and Participants: This economic evaluation analyzed the costs of a shelter-associated measles outbreak in Chicago between March 7 and April 30, 2024, in terms of measles cases, contacts (children, adult residents, shelter personnel), and relevant agencies involved in the outbreak response. Exposure: Measles virus. Main Outcomes and Measures: Three types of costs were estimated in this limited societal cost analysis: (1) total response costs (personnel time, vaccination, quarantine space, transportation, laboratory testing, and other materials) incurred by the Chicago Department of Public Health and partner agencies; (2) direct medical costs (case isolation in hospitals, emergency department visits, treatment, interfacility emergency transportation, and infrastructure modifications); and (3) productivity losses due to isolation, quarantine, or informal caregiving (including number of days children were excluded from school). Results: There were 57 measles cases (including 30 females [52.6%]; median [IQR] age, 3 [1-22] years) and 3569 contacts (including 1837 females [51.6%]; median [IQR] age, 17 [7-30] years) associated with the shelter outbreak. The associated societal cost was $8 700 258, or $152 636 per measles case. Response costs included $1 798 780 in personnel costs, $1 397 976 in vaccination costs, $200 489 in laboratory testing costs, $104 263 in transportation costs, and $63 023 in other material costs. Direct medical costs were $4 399 639, and estimated productivity losses were $683 895, with 17 113 school days among children lost due to the outbreak. Conclusions and Relevance: This economic evaluation of a measles outbreak in a congregate setting found complex response challenges that contributed to substantial costs. This outbreak response was one of the most expensive in the measles postelimination era due to the large costs associated with vaccination and isolation and quarantine in hospitals. Though the outbreak placed a considerable cost burden on both public health and health care systems, rapid disease identification and mass vaccination among shelter residents prevented a more costly and larger outbreak. Strategies to reduce disease transmission and costs during outbreaks among undervaccinated populations living in congregate settings may include funding non-health care isolation and quarantine spaces and vaccinating new shelter residents on arrival.

title: Clinical and laborator features of measles in adults
abstract: Measles continues to cause periodic epidemic outbreaks at the present stage, affecting not only children but also the adult population, with the development of various complications, particularly in individuals with comorbid conditions. This necessitates a high level of awareness among healthcare professionals regarding this nosology and further scientific investigation in this field. Aim : To provide a clinical-laboratory characterization of measles in adults and endothelial dysfunction . Methods: A prospective study was conducted including 278 (100%) patients aged over 18 years diagnosed with measles and hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department of the multidisciplinary clinic of Tashkent State Medical University between March 2022 and December 2024. The presence of immunosuppression in this patient cohort was established, manifested by transient leukopenia in 62.9% of cases, lymphopenia in 47.5%, and thrombocytopenia in 45.3%. Results : In adults, measles at the present stage was characterized not only by classical clinical manifestations but also by atypical features, including the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients. Gastrointestinal complications, primarily diarrhea, were observed in 37.8% of patients, leading to dehydration. Hepatomegaly was detected in 38.1% of cases and was associated with cytolytic syndrome. A statistically significant elevation of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) (423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL) and Creactive protein (CRP) levels (62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L) was observed in severe measles compared to moderate disease (276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL and 48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L, respectively), indicating pronounced endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between increased interleukin-1 (IL-1) levels and elevated CRP and VEGF-A concentrations, which predisposed to the development of pneumonia in 82 (29.5%) patients. Among these, 2.7% demonstrated elevated procalcitonin levels, suggesting a bacterial etiology of pneumonia. Conclusion : These findings indicate that marked endothelial dysfunction with the development of pathological angiogenesis represents one of the key pathogenetic mechanisms underlying pneumonia formation in adult patients with measles.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can cautiously inform surveillance and diagnosis of measles in adults, particularly regarding the identification of atypical clinical features and the role of endothelial dysfunction in disease progression.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational nature and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive clinical-laboratory characterization of measles in adults.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize measles in adults, focusing on clinical and laboratory features. Conducted in a prospective manner between March 2022 and December 2024, it included 278 hospitalized adult patients diagnosed with measles. The study found that measles in adults exhibited atypical features, such as the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients, and was associated with gastrointestinal complications, hepatomegaly, and endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between elevated interleukin-1 levels and the development of pneumonia in 29.5% of patients, with 2.7% showing signs of bacterial etiology. These findings highlight the importance of endothelial dysfunction in pneumonia formation in adults with measles, offering insights for improved surveillance and diagnosis. The study's evidence is strong, though its observational design may limit the confidence in causal interpretations.

title_zh: 成年人麻疹的临床和实验室特征
source_body_en: Measles continues to cause periodic epidemic outbreaks at the present stage, affecting not only children but also the adult population, with the development of various complications, particularly in individuals with comorbid conditions. This necessitates a high level of awareness among healthcare professionals regarding this nosology and further scientific investigation in this field. Aim : To provide a clinical-laboratory characterization of measles in adults and endothelial dysfunction . Methods: A prospective study was conducted including 278 (100%) patients aged over 18 years diagnosed with measles and hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department of the multidisciplinary clinic of Tashkent State Medical University between March 2022 and December 2024. The presence of immunosuppression in this patient cohort was established, manifested by transient leukopenia in 62.9% of cases, lymphopenia in 47.5%, and thrombocytopenia in 45.3%. Results : In adults, measles at the present stage was characterized not only by classical clinical manifestations but also by atypical features, including the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients. Gastrointestinal complications, primarily diarrhea, were observed in 37.8% of patients, leading to dehydration. Hepatomegaly was detected in 38.1% of cases and was associated with cytolytic syndrome. A statistically significant elevation of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) (423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL) and Creactive protein (CRP) levels (62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L) was observed in severe measles compared to moderate disease (276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL and 48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L, respectively), indicating pronounced endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between increased interleukin-1 (IL-1) levels and elevated CRP and VEGF-A concentrations, which predisposed to the development of pneumonia in 82 (29.5%) patients. Among these, 2.7% demonstrated elevated procalcitonin levels, suggesting a bacterial etiology of pneumonia. Conclusion : These findings indicate that marked endothelial dysfunction with the development of pathological angiogenesis represents one of the key pathogenetic mechanisms underlying pneumonia formation in adult patients with measles.
abstract_zh: 目前,麻疹仍会导致周期性流行性暴发,不仅影响儿童,还影响成人,尤其在合并症患者中会引发各种并发症。这要求医疗专业人员对这一病种保持高度警觉,并进一步开展该领域的科学研究。目的:探讨成年人麻疹的临床-实验室特征及其与内皮功能障碍的关系。方法:本研究为前瞻性研究,纳入了2022年3月至2024年12月期间在塔什干州立医科大学多学科诊所感染科住院的278例(100%)年龄超过18岁的麻疹确诊患者。通过检测发现,这些患者存在免疫抑制现象,表现为62.9%的病例出现暂时性白细胞减少,47.5%出现淋巴细胞减少,45.3%出现血小板减少。结果:在成年人中,目前阶段的麻疹不仅表现出经典临床症状,还具有非典型特征,包括16.5%的患者未出现典型病程进展。37.8%的患者出现胃肠道并发症,主要为腹泻,导致脱水。38.1%的病例出现肝肿大,并与细胞溶解综合征相关。与中度疾病(276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL和48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L)相比,重度麻疹患者的血管内皮生长因子A(VEGF-A)(423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL)和C反应蛋白(CRP)水平(62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L)显著升高,提示明显的内皮功能障碍。研究发现,IL-1水平升高与CRP和VEGF-A浓度升高相关,这使得82例(29.5%)患者易发展为肺炎。其中,2.7%的患者表现出升高的降钙素原水平,提示肺炎可能具有细菌病因。结论:这些发现表明,显著的内皮功能障碍伴随病理性血管生成是成人麻疹患者肺炎形成的关键发病机制之一。

title: Predicting measles outbreak magnitude via modeled population susceptibility evidence from pre-vaccination data
abstract: We characterized pre-vaccination measles dynamics using a discrete-time mechanistic model that integrates incidence time series and demographic data to estimate key epidemiological parameters and to quantify the relationship between the reconstructed population susceptibility and the observed epidemic magnitude. Weekly reported measles incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era were analyzed. A discrete-time age-of-infection model incorporating seasonality was fitted for each year. Several parameters were fixed using values from the literature, while others were estimated via maximum likelihood. Reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year (S 0 ), inferred from surveillance and demographic data, was evaluated as a predictor of subsequent observed outbreak magnitude. The model accurately reproduced the temporal dynamics of measles across all regions. Reconstructed S 0 was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, demonstrating its practical value as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size. The discrete-time age-of-infection model enables exploration of the mechanisms underlying observed incidence and epidemic dynamics. It captures the feedback between the susceptible pool and outbreak amplitude and supports one-year-ahead predictions of observed outbreak magnitude based on reconstructed susceptibility.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a method for predicting measles outbreak magnitude using pre-vaccination data to understand population susceptibility dynamics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A discrete-time mechanistic model was fitted for each year using weekly measles incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era.
analysis.methods: A discrete-time age-of-infection model incorporating seasonality was fitted for each year, with several parameters fixed using literature values and others estimated via maximum likelihood.
analysis.main_results: Reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year (S 0 ) was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, demonstrating its practical value as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The model accurately reproduced the temporal dynamics of measles across all regions, capturing the feedback between the susceptible pool and outbreak amplitude.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of reconstructed susceptibility as a tool for one-year-ahead predictions of measles outbreak magnitude, enhancing surveillance and preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on pre-vaccination data and assumes parameter stability over time, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these assumptions.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a discrete-time mechanistic model that integrates measles incidence time series and demographic data to estimate population susceptibility and predict outbreak magnitude. The model was fitted for each year using weekly incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era. Parameters were fixed using literature values and estimated via maximum likelihood. The results showed that reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, supporting its use as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size. The model accurately reproduced measles dynamics across all regions, capturing the feedback between susceptible populations and outbreak amplitude. The study's implications suggest that this approach could enhance public health preparedness by enabling one-year-ahead predictions of measles outbreaks. However, the reliance on pre-vaccination data and assumptions about parameter stability over time may limit generalizability, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该模型能够准确再现麻疹在所有地区的时序动态,捕捉了易感人群池与暴发幅度之间的反馈关系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持将重建的易感性作为预测麻疹 暴发规模的工具,用于一年期的预测,从而增强监测和应对准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于预疫苗接种数据,并假设参数随时间保持稳定,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于这些假设,证据强度中等。

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Sex-disaggregated analysis of measles incidence in Sierra Leone
abstract: Measles remains a public health challenge in Sierra Leone, a country with a history of socio-economic and health system disruptions. Despite global efforts to control and eliminate measles, regional disparities and systemic challenges persist. This study aimed to assess sex-disaggregated age-standardised incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population, using data extracted from the WHO Health Equity Monitor via the HEAT toolkit, consistent with Global Burden of Disease (GBD) methodology to inform targeted public health interventions. We conducted a sex-disaggregated analysis using data from the World Health Organization (WHO) Equity Database and the Health Equity Assessment Toolkit (HEAT). Age-standardized incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population were calculated for males and females from 2000 to 2021. Key equity metrics, including absolute difference (D), incidence rate ratio (R), population attributable fraction (PAF), and population attributable risk (PAR), were computed to evaluate sex-based disparities in measles burden over the study period. The age-standardised incidence rate declined substantially from 1,908.1 cases per 100,000 population in 2000 to 43.4 cases per 100,000 population in 2021, representing an overall reduction of approximately 97.7%. The incidence rate decreased markedly to 136.5 cases per 100,000 population in 2005, increased to 620.6 and 625.3 cases per 100,000 population in 2010 and 2015, respectively, before declining again by 2021. Sex-disaggregated analysis revealed minimal inequality, with incidence rates of 1,946.2 (95% CI 679.1-4344.0), among females and 1,868.8 (95% CI 654.1-4032.5) among males in 2000, declining to 44.2 (95% CI 26.9-64.3) and 42.6 (95% CI 26.0-62.0), respectively, in 2021. The incidence rate ratio remained constant at 1.0 throughout the study period, while the population attributable fraction ranged from -2.1% to -1.9%, indicating minimal sex-based inequality in measles incidence. Although the age-standardised measles incidence rate declined substantially between 2000 and 2021, temporary increases in 2010 and 2015 indicate that progress remains vulnerable to disruptions in routine immunisation services. Geographic and economic inequalities persisted, whereas sex-based differences were minimal. Strengthening routine immunisation systems and implementing equity-focused strategies targeting underserved populations remain essential for achieving and sustaining measles elimination in Sierra Leone.

The incidence rate ratio remained constant at 1.0 throughout the study period, while the population attributable fraction ranged from -2.1% to -1.9%, indicating minimal sex-based inequality in measles incidence. Although the age-standardised measles incidence rate declined substantially between 2000 and 2021, temporary increases in 2010 and 2015 indicate that progress remains vulnerable to disruptions in routine immunisation services. Geographic and economic inequalities persisted, whereas sex-based differences were minimal. Strengthening routine immunisation systems and implementing equity-focused strategies targeting underserved populations remain essential for achieving and sustaining measles elimination in Sierra Leone.

title: Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: How Measles Virus Adapts to the Brain
abstract: Measles virus (MeV) infection is mediated by two cellular receptors: signaling lymphocytic activation molecule family member 1 (SLAMF1, also known as CD150), expressed by immune cells, and nectin-4, expressed by epithelial cells. Infection of immune cells causes systemic disease and immune suppression, while infection of airway epithelial cells results in efficient transmission. In rare cases, MeV reaches the brain and slowly spreads in cells that do not express bona fide receptors, causing subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). In the brains of persons with SSPE, multiple mutations of the MeV membrane fusion apparatus are selected that enable its triggering by host proteins acting as surrogate receptors. These mutations favor cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based MeV genome evolution and the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs). CIUs, which can rebalance their components and rapidly adapt to new environments, may support neuropathogenesis of other nonintegrating RNA viruses, in particular those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study investigates how measles virus adapts to the brain during subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) and explores the mechanisms of viral adaptation in this context. The background highlights the dual cellular receptors used by measles virus for infection and the differing outcomes of infection in immune cells versus airway epithelial cells.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on measles virus adaptation to the brain, focusing on SSPE cases. It examines the virus's behavior in the brains of individuals with SSPE, where it spreads in cells lacking bona fide receptors.
analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing the molecular mechanisms of measles virus adaptation, particularly the mutations in the membrane fusion apparatus that allow the virus to trigger host proteins as surrogate receptors. The study also explores the implications of these mutations for viral spread and evolution.
analysis.main_results: In the brains of individuals with SSPE, multiple mutations of the measles virus membrane fusion apparatus are selected, enabling the virus to use host proteins as surrogate receptors. These mutations facilitate cell-to-cell spread and contribute to the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these mutations as favoring cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based genome evolution and the formation of CIUs. This finding is novel as it suggests a mechanism by which measles virus adapts to the brain environment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the understanding of neuropathogenesis in other nonintegrating RNA viruses, particularly those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes, and could have implications for the development of targeted therapies or diagnostic tools for SSPE.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions. However, the evidence is grounded in well-documented molecular mechanisms and is considered to have moderate confidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究探讨了麻疹病毒在亚急性硬化性全脑炎(亚急性硬化性全脑炎)期间如何适应大脑,并研究了在此背景下病毒适应的机制。背景强调了麻疹病毒用于感染的两种细胞受体,以及免疫细胞与气道上皮细胞感染所产生的不同结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对现有文献中关于麻疹病毒适应大脑的综述,重点关注亚急性硬化性全脑炎病例。它研究了病毒在患有亚急性硬化性全脑炎的个体大脑中的行为,其中病毒在不表达真正受体的细胞中扩散。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究方法涉及分析麻疹病毒适应的分子机制,特别是膜融合装置中的突变,这些突变使病毒能够通过宿主蛋白作为替代受体被触发。此外,该研究还探讨了这些突变对病毒传播和进化的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在患有亚急性硬化性全脑炎的个体大脑中,麻疹病毒膜融合装置的多个突变被选择,使得病毒能够利用宿主蛋白作为替代受体。这些突变促进了细胞间传播,并有助于集体感染单位(CIUs)的形成。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些突变解释为有利于细胞间传播,从而促进基于群体的基因组 进化以及集体感染单位(CIUs)的形成。这一发现具有新颖性,因为它提出了麻疹病毒如何适应大脑环境的机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于理解其他非整合RNA病毒的神经发病机制,特别是那些具有非分节负链基因组的病毒,并可能对亚急性硬化性全脑炎的靶向治疗或诊断工具的开发产生影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于现有文献,未包含新的实验数据,这可能限制结论的强度。然而,这些证据建立在已广泛记录的分子机制之上,被认为具有中等置信度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study investigates how measles virus adapts to the brain during subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) and explores the mechanisms of viral adaptation in this context. The background highlights the dual cellular receptors used by measles virus for infection and the differing outcomes of infection in immune cells versus airway epithelial cells.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on measles virus adaptation to the brain, focusing on SSPE cases. It examines the virus's behavior in the brains of individuals with SSPE, where it spreads in cells lacking bona fide receptors.
analysis_en.methods: The methods involve analyzing the molecular mechanisms of measles virus adaptation, particularly the mutations in the membrane fusion apparatus that allow the virus to trigger host proteins as surrogate receptors. The study also explores the implications of these mutations for viral spread and evolution.
analysis_en.main_results: In the brains of individuals with SSPE, multiple mutations of the measles virus membrane fusion apparatus are selected, enabling the virus to use host proteins as surrogate receptors. These mutations facilitate cell-to-cell spread and contribute to the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these mutations as favoring cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based genome evolution and the formation of CIUs. This finding is novel as it suggests a mechanism by which measles virus adapts to the brain environment.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the understanding of neuropathogenesis in other nonintegrating RNA viruses, particularly those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes, and could have implications for the development of targeted therapies or diagnostic tools for SSPE.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions. However, the evidence is grounded in well-documented molecular mechanisms and is considered to have moderate confidence.

title_zh: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎: 麻疹病毒如何适应大脑
source_body_en: Measles virus (MeV) infection is mediated by two cellular receptors: signaling lymphocytic activation molecule family member 1 (SLAMF1, also known as CD150), expressed by immune cells, and nectin-4, expressed by epithelial cells. Infection of immune cells causes systemic disease and immune suppression, while infection of airway epithelial cells results in efficient transmission. In rare cases, MeV reaches the brain and slowly spreads in cells that do not express bona fide receptors, causing subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). In the brains of persons with SSPE, multiple mutations of the MeV membrane fusion apparatus are selected that enable its triggering by host proteins acting as surrogate receptors. These mutations favor cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based MeV genome evolution and the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs). CIUs, which can rebalance their components and rapidly adapt to new environments, may support neuropathogenesis of other nonintegrating RNA viruses, in particular those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes.
abstract_zh: 麻疹病毒(麻疹病毒)感染通过两种细胞受体介导:由免疫细胞表达的信号淋巴细胞活化分子家族成员1(SLAMF1,也称为CD150),以及由上皮细胞表达的nectin-4。免疫细胞感染会导致全身性疾病和免疫抑制,而气道上皮细胞感染则会导致高效的传播。在极少数情况下,麻疹病毒会进入大脑并在不表达真正受体的细胞中缓慢扩散,从而引发亚急性硬化性全脑炎(亚急性硬化性全脑炎)。在患有亚急性硬化性全脑炎的患者大脑中,麻疹病毒膜融合装置的多个突变被选择,这些突变使得病毒能够通过宿主蛋白作为替代受体被触发。这些突变有利于细胞间传播,从而促进基于群体的麻疹病毒基因组 进化以及集体感染单位(CIUs)的形成。CIUs能够重新平衡其组分并迅速适应新环境,可能支持其他非整合RNA病毒的神经发病机制,特别是那些具有非分节负链基因组的病毒。

title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: Development and Internal Validation of a Clinical Prediction Model for Severe Measles Outcomes Among Hospitalized Children During the 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh
abstract: This study will develop and internally validate a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. Routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital will be used for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. Demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors will be assessed as predictors. Severe outcome will include death, intensive care admission, mechanical ventilation, severe pneumonia requiring oxygen, or severe neurological complications. A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used. Model discrimination and calibration will be assessed. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score. External validation will be required before wider use.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to develop a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. The rationale was to address the need for a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles complications.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study is an internal validation of a clinical prediction model using routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. The population includes hospitalized children during the 2026 measles outbreak.
analysis_en.methods: A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used to develop and validate the prediction model. The model will incorporate demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors as predictors.
analysis_en.main_results: The study will assess model discrimination and calibration to evaluate the performance of the clinical prediction model. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors will interpret the model's performance in terms of its ability to predict severe measles outcomes accurately. The novelty lies in the development of a risk score that can be used in clinical settings.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform clinical decision-making by providing a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles outcomes. This may aid in targeted interventions and resource allocation during outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to internal validation, and external validation will be required before wider use. The evidence is based on routine hospital records, which may introduce biases or missing data.

title_zh: 2026年孟加拉国麻疹疫情期间住院儿童严重麻疹结局的临床预测模型的开发与内部验证
source_body_en: This study will develop and internally validate a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. Routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital will be used for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. Demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors will be assessed as predictors. Severe outcome will include death, intensive care admission, mechanical ventilation, severe pneumonia requiring oxygen, or severe neurological complications. A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used. Model discrimination and calibration will be assessed. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score. External validation will be required before wider use.

title: Trained Immunity in Childhood Vaccination.
abstract: Conventionally, vaccine design has focused on identifying antigens that induce durable T and B cell memory and provide long term protection against subsequent encounters with the same pathogen. Unconventionally, a growing number of epidemiological, preclinical, and clinical studies demonstrate that live vaccines, including Bacillus Calmette Guérin (BCG), measles-containing vaccines, and oral polio vaccine, induce protection through trained immunity, a form of metabolically and epigenetically mediated memory in innate immune cells and their progenitors. This concept is particularly relevant during early life, when adaptive immune responses are constrained and innate immunity represents the principal line of host defence. In this review, we discuss the unique characteristics of neonatal and infant immunity, summarize current evidence for trained immunity induced by childhood vaccines, and describe the bidirectional interplay between innate and adaptive immune memory. We further highlight the potential of trained immunity to broaden protection against severe infections, improve vaccine efficacy, and provide therapeutic opportunities for non-infectious paediatric diseases, including cancer and allergic disorders. Harnessing trained immunity represents a conceptual shift in paediatric vaccinology and may guide the development of next generation vaccines that provide broader and more resilient protection during the period of greatest immunological vulnerability.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于儿童疫苗背景下训练免疫的概念,特别是探讨含有麻疹的疫苗如何通过固有免疫记忆机制诱导保护。核心问题是训练免疫是否能够增强疫苗效力并提供对严重感染和非感染性儿科疾病的更广泛保护。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对现有文献的概念性分析,总结了流行病学、临床前和临床研究中显示训练免疫在活疫苗(如含有麻疹的疫苗)中作用的证据。它并未报告特定数据库、检索日期或元分析方法,而是概述了从这些研究中综合发现的一般方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,训练免疫通过固有免疫细胞及其前体介导,在含有麻疹的疫苗的保护作用中起着重要作用。它强调了固有免疫和适应性免疫记忆之间的双向相互作用,特别是在生命早期适应性反应有限的情况下尤为重要。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述承认,尽管训练免疫是一个有前景的领域,但其机制和保护范围仍存在未解决的问题。同时,它指出相关证据仍在发展中,需要更多研究来全面理解其对疫苗设计和儿科健康的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,理解训练免疫可能有助于开发下一代具有更广泛和更稳固保护的疫苗。它还强调了训练免疫在非感染性儿科疾病(如癌症和过敏性疾病)中的潜在治疗应用。

title_zh: 儿童时期训练免疫
source_body_en: Conventionally, vaccine design has focused on identifying antigens that induce durable T and B cell memory and provide long term protection against subsequent encounters with the same pathogen. abstract_zh: 传统上,疫苗设计的重点在于识别能够诱导持久T细胞和B细胞记忆并提供长期保护以应对相同病原体再次接触的抗原。然而,非传统地,越来越多的流行病学、临床前和临床研究显示,活疫苗,包括卡介苗(BCG)、含有麻疹的疫苗以及口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗,通过训练免疫提供保护,这是一种由代谢和表观遗传介导的固有免疫细胞及其前体的记忆形式。这一概念在生命早期尤为重要,因为适应性免疫在这一阶段受到限制,而固有免疫构成了主要的防御机制。在本综述中,我们将讨论新生儿和婴儿免疫的独特特征,总结目前关于儿童疫苗诱导训练免疫的证据,并描述固有免疫和适应性免疫记忆之间的双向相互作用。我们进一步强调了训练免疫在扩大对严重感染的保护范围、提高疫苗效力以及为非感染性儿科疾病(包括癌症和过敏性疾病)提供治疗机会方面的潜力。利用训练免疫代表了儿科疫苗学概念上的转变,可能指导下一代疫苗的开发,以在免疫系统最脆弱的时期提供更广泛和更稳固的保护。

title: Dermatological Manifestations of Emergent Viruses. Part I: Common and Vaccine-Preventable Viral Infections.
abstract: Viral infections frequently present with mucocutaneous manifestations that may provide diagnostic clues and guide timely management. However, the expanding therapeutic landscape and evolving public health recommendations highlight the need for an updated evidence-based review for dermatologists. Herein, we summarize the epidemiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of common and vaccine-preventable viral infections with dermatologic relevance, including Coronavirus Disease-2019 (COVID-19), mpox, measles, and rubella. Advances in antiviral therapies, immunomodulators, vaccination, and post-exposure prophylaxis have improved outcomes for several infections. Recognition of characteristic skin findings, familiarity with current diagnostic approaches, and implementation of evidence-based prevention strategies are essential for early diagnosis, appropriate treatment, and limiting disease transmission.
journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

The central question is to summarize the epidemiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of common and vaccine-preventable viral infections with dermatologic relevance, including measles.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is an evidence-based summary of the dermatological manifestations of viral infections. It includes an overview of the therapeutic landscape and public health recommendations, but does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that viral infections frequently present with mucocutaneous manifestations that may provide diagnostic clues and guide timely management. It emphasizes the importance of recognizing characteristic skin findings, understanding current diagnostic approaches, and implementing prevention strategies for early diagnosis and limiting disease transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that advances in antiviral therapies, immunomodulators, vaccination, and post-exposure prophylaxis have improved outcomes for several infections. However, it does not report on specific controversies or evidence gaps related to measles virus.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the need for an updated evidence-based review for dermatologists due to the expanding therapeutic landscape and evolving public health recommendations. It also stresses the importance of recognizing characteristic skin findings and implementing prevention strategies.

The findings are based on a summary of the therapeutic landscape and public health recommendations, with no explicit mention of controversies or evidence gaps.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述强调,病毒感染常表现为黏膜皮肤症状,这些症状可能提供诊断线索并指导及时的管理。它强调了识别特征性皮肤表现、理解当前诊断方法以及实施预防策略对于早期诊断和限制疾病传播的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,在抗病毒药物疗法、免疫调节剂、疫苗接种以及暴露后预防措施方面的进展已改善了多种感染的预后。然而,它并未报告与麻疹病毒相关的具体争议或证据缺口。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调,由于治疗领域不断扩展和公共卫生建议不断演变,皮肤科医生需要更新的基于证据的综述。它还强调了识别特征性皮肤表现和实施预防策略的重要性。}}.{

title: Evaluation of surveillance performance and determinants for priority vaccine-preventable diseases in Niger State, Nigeria: A CDC 2001 Guideline-based multilevel analysis
abstract: Vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs) remain important causes of morbidity and mortality in sub-Saharan Africa, and evidence on subnational surveillance performance in Nigeria remains limited. We conducted a cross-sectional analytic evaluation of surveillance systems for measles, diphtheria, acute flaccid paralysis (AFP), and cerebrospinal meningitis (CSM) in Niger State, Nigeria. Data were collected from 415 clinicians, community resource persons, and surveillance focal persons across 12 purposively selected Local Government Areas using structured questionnaires adapted from CDC surveillance evaluation guidelines and aligned with IDSR guidance. Surveillance performance was assessed using sensitivity, data quality, and stability. Analyses included descriptive statistics, bivariate tests, and multivariable regression models. Reported suspected case detection was higher for measles and AFP than for CSM and diphtheria, with detection reported by 94.2% and 93.0% of respondents for measles and AFP, respectively, compared with 84.3% for CSM and 81.4% for diphtheria. Transport availability without delays was consistently associated with lower odds of surveillance failure across disease-specific models, including measles sample collection (aOR = 0.12, 95% CI: 0.05-0.28) and case confirmation (aOR = 0.07, 95% CI: 0.02-0.21), diphtheria sample collection (aOR = 0.18, 95% CI: 0.06-0.49) and confirmation (aOR = 0.22, 95% CI: 0.08-0.58), and CSM sample collection (aOR = 0.18, 95% CI: 0.06-0.54) and confirmation (aOR = 0.21, 95% CI: 0.07-0.61). Active guideline use was associated with AFP sample collection (aOR = 4.12, 95% CI: 1.72-9.87). Only 66.5% of respondents reported fully accurate submitted forms, and financial support was associated with lower odds of instability (aOR = 0.74, 95% CI: 0.56-0.97). Strengthening transport, infrastructure, financing, and data quality systems may improve VPD surveillance performance and outbreak preparedness in similar settings.

title: Catching up in crisis: implementation of the big Catch-Up initiative in Yemen within a context of fragile routine immunization systems
abstract: Abstract Background Decades of conflict in Yemen have decimated routine immunization infrastructure, produced a large population of zero-dose children, and precipitated recurring outbreaks of measles, diphtheria, pertussis, and polio. The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic further widened coverage gaps. This paper examines how pre-existing system fragility shaped the implementation and outcomes of the Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative in southern Yemen. Methods A mixed-methods case study was conducted in southern Yemen in 2025. Data sources included administrative immunization records, key informant interviews ( n = 40), focus group discussions ( n = 12), a vaccinator survey ( n = 242), and observation of 40 vaccination sessions. Qualitative data were analyzed thematically; quantitative data were analyzed descriptively. Findings were triangulated across sources. Results By July 2025, national BCU administrative reach against nationally estimated antigen-specific targets was 7% for the first dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta1), 3.7% for the third dose (Penta3), and 7.6% for the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1), with children aged 24–59 months reached at consistently lower rates. Implementation was launched in September 2024 in southern Yemen amid system-level failures rooted in pre-existing fragility. The administrative reach in southern Yemen shows variations in vaccine-specific type and dose and geography. Updated tools and standard operating procedures arrived months after activities commenced; microplanning relied on a 2004 census that failed to account for mass displacement; demand-generation activities were underfunded; training was brief; and field supervision was consistently weak. Concurrent outbreak responses further strained the workforce. Distance, transport cost, restrictions on some women’s mobility, rumors, and fear of adverse events were also reported as barriers, particularly for older children. Insufficient attention to social and behavior change activities created additional barriers to uptake. Conclusions External financing and policy commitment may be insufficient for equitable catch-up vaccination when implementation depends on a fragile, conflict-affected health system – the same weaknesses that have long undermined routine immunization in the country. Time-bound campaigns cannot substitute for sustained primary health care investment, meaningful community engagement, improved population estimates, and financing models that extend beyond donor project cycles.
journal: International Journal for Equity in Health

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the implementation of the Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative in southern Yemen, focusing on measles virus-related challenges. The paper highlights how pre-existing system fragility, exacerbated by decades of conflict and the COVID-19 pandemic, hindered vaccine coverage. Administrative data show low reach for measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) and pentavalent vaccine (Penta1/Penta3), particularly among children aged 24–59 months. Mixed-methods analysis revealed systemic issues, including delayed tools, outdated census data, underfunded demand-generation, brief training, and weak supervision. Barriers such as distance, transport costs, mobility restrictions, rumors, and fear of adverse events were reported, especially for older children. The study concludes that external financing and policy commitment alone are insufficient for equitable catch-up vaccination in fragile health systems, emphasizing the need for sustained primary health care investment, community engagement, improved population estimates, and long-term financing models.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 麻疹病毒(Morbillivirus hominis),历史分类名称,麻疹和麻疹疾病。生物相关动物、分类、模型、差异诊断和比较实体仅作为补充,除非存在针对目标的实质性证据;只有明确的词汇或无关的硬性排除才是最终的。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2025年在也门南部开展了一项混合方法案例研究。数据来源包括行政免疫记录、关键信息提供者访谈(n=40)、焦点小组讨论(n=12)、疫苗接种人员调查(n=242)以及对40个疫苗接种活动的观察。定性数据采用主题分析法,定量数据采用描述性分析法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 截至2025年7月,全国BCU行动的行政覆盖率达到全国估计抗原特异性目标的7%(第一剂五联疫苗Penta1),3.7%(第三剂Penta3),以及7.6%(含麻疹病毒的第一次疫苗接种MCV1),其中24-59个月龄儿童的覆盖率为持续较低。研究结果通过多源交叉验证。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 更新的工具和标准操作程序在活动开始后数月才到达;微规划依赖于2004年的普查,未能考虑大规模人口流动;需求生成活动资金不足;培训时间短;现场监督始终薄弱。距离、交通成本、部分女性行动受限、谣言以及对不良事件的恐惧也被报告为障碍,尤其是对较大儿童而言。对社会和行为改变活动的关注不足,也造成了额外的接种障碍。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 时限性活动无法替代持续的初级卫生保健投资、有意义的社区参与、改进的人口估计以及超越捐助者项目周期的融资模式。

The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic further widened coverage gaps. This paper examines how pre-existing system fragility shaped the implementation and outcomes of the Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative in southern Yemen. Methods A mixed-methods case study was conducted in southern Yemen in 2025. Data sources included administrative immunization records, key informant interviews ( n = 40), focus group discussions ( n = 12), a vaccinator survey ( n = 242), and observation of 40 vaccination sessions. Qualitative data were analyzed thematically; quantitative data were analyzed descriptively. Findings were triangulated across sources. Results By July 2025, national BCU administrative reach against nationally estimated antigen-specific targets was 7% for the first dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta1), 3.7% for the third dose (Penta3), and 7.6% for the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1), with children aged 24–59 months reached at consistently lower rates. Implementation was launched in September 2024 in southern Yemen amid system-level failures rooted in pre-existing fragility. The administrative reach in southern Yemen shows variations in vaccine-specific type and dose and geography. Updated tools and standard operating procedures arrived months after activities commenced; microplanning relied on a 2004 census that failed to account for mass displacement; demand-generation activities were underfunded; training was brief; and field supervision was consistently weak. Concurrent outbreak responses further strained the workforce. Distance, transport cost, restrictions on some women’s mobility, rumors, and fear of adverse events were also reported as barriers, particularly for older children. Insufficient attention to social and behavior change activities created additional barriers to uptake. Conclusions External financing and policy commitment may be insufficient for equitable catch-up vaccination when implementation depends on a fragile, conflict-affected health system – the same weaknesses that have long undermined routine immunization in the country. Time-bound campaigns cannot substitute for sustained primary health care investment, meaningful community engagement, improved population estimates, and financing models that extend beyond donor project cycles.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 也门数十年的冲突摧毁了常规免疫基础设施,导致大量零剂儿童,并引发了麻疹、白喉、百日咳和脊髓灰质炎的反复暴发。2019年冠状病毒病(COVID-19)大流行进一步扩大了覆盖率差距。本文探讨了在也门南部实施大追赶(BCU)行动时,原有系统脆弱性如何影响其实施和结果。方法 2025年在也门南部开展了一项混合方法案例研究。数据来源包括行政免疫记录、关键信息提供者访谈(n=40)、焦点小组讨论(n=12)、疫苗接种人员调查(n=242)以及对40个疫苗接种活动的观察。定性数据采用主题分析法,定量数据采用描述性分析法。研究结果通过多源交叉验证。结果 截至2025年7月,全国BCU行动的行政覆盖率达到全国估计抗原特异性目标的7%(第一剂五联疫苗Penta1),3.7%(第三剂Penta3),以及7.6%(含麻疹病毒的第一次疫苗接种MCV1),其中24-59个月龄儿童的覆盖率为持续较低。该行动于2024年9月在也门南部启动,当时系统层面的失败源于原有系统的脆弱性。也门南部的行政覆盖率在疫苗类型、剂量和地理区域上存在差异。更新的工具和标准操作程序在活动开始后数月才到达;微规划依赖于2004年的普查,未能考虑大规模人口流动;需求生成活动资金不足;培训时间短;现场监督始终薄弱。同时进行的麻疹应对措施进一步加剧了人力资源的紧张。距离、交通成本、部分女性行动受限、谣言以及对不良事件的恐惧也被报告为障碍,尤其是对较大儿童而言。对社会和行为改变活动的关注不足,也造成了额外的接种障碍。结论 当实施依赖于脆弱、受冲突影响的卫生系统时,外部资金和政策承诺可能不足以实现公平的麻疹追赶行动——这些弱点长期以来一直阻碍着该国的常规免疫工作。时限性活动无法替代持续的初级卫生保健投资、有意义的社区参与、改进的人口估计以及超越捐助者项目周期的融资模式。

title: When health facilities close, outbreaks follow: the public health consequences of aid cuts in Somalia.
abstract: Somalia's fragile health system is increasingly threatened by reductions in humanitarian financing, with potentially serious consequences for outbreak prevention and public-health preparedness. Recent funding cuts have already resulted in the closure of health and nutrition facilities and substantial reductions in service coverage, with further closures projected under severe funding scenarios. These disruptions extend beyond reduced access to curative care; they may interrupt routine immunization, nutrition screening and treatment, disease surveillance, referral pathways, and early outbreak detection. This is particularly concerning in Somalia, where recurrent measles, cholera, and diphtheria outbreaks occur amid persistent immunization gaps, displacement, conflict, and malnutrition. The 2025 diphtheria resurgence, alongside a substantial population of zero-dose children, demonstrates the risks associated with weak prevention systems. At the same time, the high burden of acute malnutrition increases vulnerability to infectious disease and places additional pressure on already constrained health services. Protecting health facilities should therefore be considered a core outbreak-prevention priority. Sustained financing for primary health care, routine immunization, nutrition, surveillance, and emergency preparedness is essential, particularly in underserved and high-risk communities. Strengthening domestic financing and contingency mechanisms will also be critical to maintaining essential services during future funding shocks and preventing avoidable deterioration in Somalia's public-health resilience.

title_zh: 当卫生设施关闭时,暴发随之而来:索马里人道主义资金削减对公共卫生的影响。

abstract_zh: 索马里的脆弱卫生体系正日益受到人道主义资金削减的威胁,这可能对暴发预防和公共卫生准备产生严重后果。最近的资金削减已经导致卫生和营养设施的关闭以及服务覆盖率的大幅下降,在严重资金短缺的情况下,预计还会出现更多设施关闭。这些中断不仅限于减少对治疗服务的可及性;它们可能中断常规免疫接种、营养筛查和治疗,影响疾病监测,中断转诊途径,并阻碍早期暴发的检测。这在索马里尤其令人担忧,因为该国反复出现麻疹、霍乱和白喉暴发,同时存在持续的免疫接种缺口、人口流离失所、冲突和营养不良问题。2025年的白喉疫情回升,以及大量零剂儿童人口的存在,凸显了预防系统薄弱所带来的风险。同时,急性营养不良的高负担增加了对传染病的易感性,并给本已受限的卫生服务带来了额外压力。因此,保护卫生设施应被视为暴发预防的核心优先事项。持续的资金支持对于初级卫生保健、常规免疫接种、营养、监测以及应急准备至关重要,尤其是在未被充分服务和高风险社区中。加强国内资金和应急机制对于在未来资金冲击期间维持基本服务并防止索马里公共卫生韧性的不可挽回恶化也至关重要。

title: Determinants of childhood vaccination differ between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions in Cameroon
abstract: Introduction Childhood vaccination remains one of the most effective public health interventions, yet coverage is often lowest in settings affected by conflict and structural disadvantage. Cameroon has faced overlapping humanitarian crises in its Far North, North-West, and South-West regions, but evidence comparing determinants of full vaccination between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions remains limited. This study explores determinants of full vaccination status in 12–23 months children in Cameroon, stratified by conflict regions. Methods We conducted a secondary analysis of the 2018 Cameroon Demographic and Health Survey, including 1,824 living children aged 12–23 months. Full basic vaccination was defined as receipt of one dose of BCG, three doses of pentavalent vaccine, three doses of polio vaccine, and one dose of measles vaccine. Survey-weighted logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with full vaccination overall and by conflict status. Results Overall, 53.08% of children were fully vaccinated. Coverage was lower in conflict-affected than in non-conflict regions (45.29% versus 55.97%). In unadjusted analysis, conflict status was associated with lower odds of full vaccination, but this association was no longer significant in the adjusted model. At the national level, higher odds of full vaccination were associated with richer household wealth, maternal secondary or higher education, antenatal care attendance, and postnatal care. In conflict-affected regions, maternal secondary or higher education, postnatal care, and facility delivery remained significant predictors of full vaccination. Discussion Full vaccination coverage in Cameroon remains below desirable levels, with lower crude coverage in conflict-affected regions. However, after adjustment, conflict status was not independently associated with full vaccination, suggesting that socioeconomic conditions and contact with maternal health services are more important determinants. Strengthening antenatal and postnatal care and reducing socioeconomic barriers may improve vaccination coverage, especially in fragile settings.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates determinants of full vaccination status in 12–23 months children in Cameroon, stratified by conflict regions. The focus is on measles virus and related entities, with the central question being how conflict status influences vaccination coverage.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a secondary analysis of the 2018 Cameroon Demographic and Health Survey, which included 1,824 living children aged 12–23 months. Survey-weighted logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with full vaccination overall and by conflict status.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Overall, 53.08% of children were fully vaccinated. Coverage was lower in conflict-affected regions (45.29%) compared to non-conflict regions (55.97%). However, after adjustment for socioeconomic and healthcare factors, conflict status was not independently associated with full vaccination, indicating that socioeconomic conditions and maternal health services are more significant predictors.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study notes that evidence comparing determinants of full vaccination between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions remains limited. Additionally, the association between conflict status and vaccination coverage was not significant in the adjusted model, suggesting potential confounding factors.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Strengthening antenatal and postnatal care and reducing socioeconomic barriers may improve vaccination coverage, especially in fragile settings. The findings highlight the importance of addressing structural disadvantages and improving access to maternal health services to enhance vaccination rates.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the determinants of childhood vaccination in Cameroon, focusing on measles virus and related entities. It finds that overall vaccination coverage is 53.08%, with lower rates in conflict-affected regions. However, after adjusting for socioeconomic and healthcare factors, conflict status alone is not a significant predictor of vaccination coverage. The research suggests that improving maternal health services and reducing socioeconomic barriers could enhance vaccination rates in conflict-affected areas. The study highlights the need for targeted interventions to address disparities in vaccination coverage, particularly in fragile settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究调查了喀麦隆12-23个月儿童疫苗接种完整接种状态的决定因素,并按冲突地区进行分层分析。研究重点是麻疹病毒及其相关实体,核心问题是冲突状态如何影响疫苗接种的覆盖率。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于2018年喀麦隆人口与健康调查的二次分析,该调查包括1,824名12-23个月的存活儿童。使用调查加权逻辑回归分析来识别与完整疫苗接种相关的因素,包括总体和按冲突状态分层的情况。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 总体而言,53.08%的儿童完成了完整接种。在冲突影响地区,接种覆盖率(45.29%)低于非冲突地区(55.97%)。然而,在调整了社会经济和医疗因素后,冲突状态与完整疫苗接种之间没有独立关联,表明社会经济状况和母亲健康服务是更为重要的预测因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本研究指出,比较冲突影响地区与非冲突地区儿童完整疫苗接种决定因素的证据仍然有限。此外,冲突状态与疫苗接种覆盖率之间的关联在调整模型中并不显著,这表明可能存在混杂因素。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强产前和产后护理,减少社会经济障碍,可能会提高疫苗接种的覆盖率,特别是在脆弱环境中。研究结果强调了应对结构性劣势和改善母亲健康服务获取的重要性,以提高疫苗接种接种率。
